levels.surface: إسماعيل بن عبد الرحمن بن ذؤيب

notes: «- يعني كتب إليه -» is an editor's gloss, left out
«عند عبد الله بن عمر» is the place of the journey; Ibn Umar speaks («رأيت رسول الله») and is the last link
the two «رواه ...» remarks name other transmitters for the same story, so they are variant groups and never routes of this saying
